8.16. iLock_Geography.geo_util¶

The module defines utility classes and convenience functions.

Functions

cart(*args) Iterator over Cartesian product of sets
createOrdinalRange(userType, bound, …[, …]) Create ordinals (as GenericOutsideObject) and add them to railyard.
getUserTypesCharFunction(userTypes) Create a characteristic function of user types.
nonStringIterableCheck(si)
objectKey(obj) Return the name of the railyard object.
popFirstElem(it) Pop off the first element of an iterator in a safe way.
stringIterable2set(si) Return a string set from a string iterable.
stringIterable2tuple(si) Return a string tuple from a string iterable.
tupleKey(t) Return a tuple of names of objects in t.
unique(pathIterableList[, seen]) Removes repeated paths generated by PathGenerator.

Classes

Memoize(fn) A decorator data type using memoization to avoid expensive computations.
MutableRailyard(graph, paths, areas, auxObjs) A data type used to generate a new railyard after processing and setting coordinate attributes to the containing railyard objects.
SafeIter(iterable) An iterator like data type.
TupleWrapper(*arg) A tuple wrapper.
